act.name: Guardians and Wards Act, 1890
act.source_authority: Ministry of Law and Justice, Government of India
act.description: Central law governing court appointment and supervision of guardians for a minor's person or property.

sections.title: Matters to be considered by the Court in appointing guardian.
sections.text: Section 17 lists matters the court considers when appointing a guardian, guided by the welfare of the minor.
sections.plain_language_summary: The court considers the minor's welfare, age, sex, religion, proposed guardian's character and capacity, wishes of a deceased parent and the child's intelligent preference.
